t: Consuming Faith: Integrating Who We Are with What We Buy - Tom Beaudoin - Google Books
s: Americans search for identity through a stunning and paradoxical pair of passions: spirituality and consumerism. We participate in religion or practice spirituality on the one hand, and are keen consumers on the other. But, as Tom Beaudoin's Consuming Faith makes clear, if we truly seek to put our spirituality into practice, we are called to integrate who we are with what we buy.In our consumer-driven culture what we buy, wear, eat, and drive say much about our deepest values.
